kills.property: Calling withdrawAll must never change the contract's owner: owner after the call equals owner before the call.
kills.change_summary: Inserted an assignment that sets owner to _recipient after the transfer, changing the publicly readable owner variable.

kills.property: If withdrawAll succeeds, it must drain the entire contract balance, leaving address(c).balance equal to 0.
kills.change_summary: Transfer a fixed 1 wei instead of the full contract balance.

kills.property: When the caller is the contract's owner, withdrawAll must succeed for any recipient; the mutant reverts instead.
kills.change_summary: Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can trigger the withdrawal.

kills.property: A successful withdrawAll by the owner drains the contract's entire balance, leaving address(c).balance equal to zero.
kills.change_summary: Transfer only half of the contract balance instead of the full balance.
